cards.name: card_cromat
cards.review_note: Retain legend/GAA gates and all five modes. CAN destruction checks BW; ACT destruction availability deliberately checks BG while DIALOG charges BW. Forced regeneration charges BG. Both blocking callbacks and six-entry switch table need separate pins before application.

cards.name: card_master_of_predicaments
cards.review_note: Retain combat-damage multiplicity and APNAP hand loop. Inlined private ability selects forced/max-value nonland for AI, fallback ANY, reads IID without a second failure guard, guesses CMC >4 or <=4, shows selected card and offers play-free only on wrong guess. Pin full private helper and its prompts.

cards.name: card_obelisk_of_alara2
cards.review_note: Retain five mana/target modes and six-entry switch. Duplicate initialization of td_own_creature leaves attacking TD largely uninitialized; this exact native bug is preserved. Own pumps use player and parent_card; no controller correction.

cards.name: card_selvalas_stampede
cards.review_note: Retain Wild/Free votes, VLA reveal, reverse scan, raw topdeck/shuffle and free hand-to-play tutor. added[] count never increments and no put-into-play loop exists in native code; preserve the upstream bug. Readonly zero-byte terminator load is a compiler copy detail, not changed behavior.

cards.name: card_aethermages_touch
cards.review_note: Native entire body is xor eax,eax;ret. Retain active #if 1 return-zero stub and leave inactive incomplete implementation untouched. Do not implement printed card rules absent native code.

cards.name: card_atogatog
cards.review_note: Retain legend and Atog positive-power/nonself restriction, power-based shade and sacrificed-power report. new_can_sacrifice_as_cost(player,1,&test) really uses card1. Empty constructor prompt requires explicit evidence.

cards.name: card_phantatog
cards.review_note: Retain boost max(0,enchantment sacs)+max(0,hand), generic 1/1 pump and activation. If either hand or sac option is absent, native takes discard path anyway; only both available produces chooser. Empty constructor prompt requires explicit evidence.

cards.name: card_rites_of_initiation
cards.review_note: Retain CAN basic and cast AI creature-count*8. Inlined discard helper never populates hcc, returns0 after test construction; resolution pumps0/0 then kills spell. Do not repair native discard bug.

cards.name: card_rites_of_refusal
cards.review_note: Retain counterspell validation and GS_COUNTERSPELL facade. Inlined broken discard helper yields0 for counter-unless-pay, then destroys spell. Prompt belongs to full private helper.

cards.name: card_rites_of_spring
cards.review_note: Retain cast AI min(hand*8,(7-lands)*8), get_total_available_lands argument side effect, inlined helper constant0, deck browse and shuffle, kill/basic. No discard/tutor work survives in native body.

cards.name: card_sacred_rites
cards.review_note: Retain basic CAN and resolve test construction, 0/0 pump and spell destruction. Inlined private discard helper returns0 because its hand-copy count is never filled.

cards.name: card_goblin_welder
cards.review_note: Retain unlock5, own/opponent/any artifact TDs and artifact-grave tests; 84-byte TD copy; mana0 and choose/cancel/tap. Inner opponent availability repeats own-grave/shroud checks. Resolution reanimates even when can_sacrifice forbids the chosen sacrifice. Native bugs preserved; readonly byte load is string terminator copy.

cards.name: card_return_to_the_ranks
cards.review_note: Retain convoke null-cost flags, CMC<3 recycler/X eligibility, free/copied handling, grave/mana/untapped-creature bounds capped19, copied info_slot override and shroud AI penalty. Exact empty constructor prompt, formatted prompts, two VLAs, selected-slot invalidation and source-ID target records match native. sc0 and chosen0 return without destruction, and number_of_targets remains0; preserve these native quirks. Ghidra loses variadic sprintf argument but existing source and complete machine instructions retain max_cards.

cards.name: card_tamiyos_emblem
cards.review_note: Retain +99 hand limit, enable milled xtrigger, AI reverse source-ID lookup/return/invalidate and human repeated 500-entry IID/index chooser. Other-zone helper uses gy_from_anywhere_source/pos then invalidates pos regardless of lookup success. Pin named BSS global identity; no raw writable-data hashing.

cards.name: card_scrambleverse
cards.review_note: Retain four APNAP passes: random nonland marking, reverse control transfer through temporary state bits, forward untap, then reverse legend recheck. suppress_legend_rule is set1 then0 around first three passes. Preserve all native flags, loop directions and basic_spell facade.

cards.name: card_mana_vault
cards.review_note: Retain humiliation guard, no-untap, optional human upkeep4 and AI randomized4/6 threshold. Static nesting counter brackets count_mana and resolving payment; paid sets info_slot36/untaps. Draw/AI damage1, tap3colorless, mana-query exclusion during nested AI payment, turn reset and native AI heuristics all match. Pin static BSS symbol and owner-local scope.

cards.name: card_rock_hydra
cards.review_note: Retain X storage and AI24*(X-3), ETB counters, prevention eligibility99 and R versus RRR modes. Fixed EXE indirect call0x458920 takes player/card/-1, fixed phase owner0x60a534 and AI word0x736808 stay exact. Target callback, valid damage decrement/cancel, counter addition and automatic prevention min(counters,damage) match. Indirect-call warning is resolved only for this explicit fixed EXE contract, not globally.

source_constants.name: APNAP
source_constants.pattern:
\#define\ APNAP\(playervar,\ \.\.\.\)\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\\\
\	do\ \{\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\\\
\	\	int\ playervar;\ int\ macro_apnap;\	/\*\ avoid\ comma\ \*/\	\	\\\
\	\	for\ \(macro_apnap\ =\ 0;\ macro_apnap\ <=\ 1;\ \+\+macro_apnap\)\{\	\\\
\	\	\	playervar\ =\ current_turn\ \^\ macro_apnap;\	\	\	\	\\\
\	\	\	\{__VA_ARGS__;\}\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\\\
\	\	\}\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\\\
\	\}\ while\ \(0\)

source_constants.name: CYCLE_ALL_CARDS
source_constants.pattern: \#define\ CYCLE_ALL_CARDS\(playervar,\ cardvar,\ \.\.\.\)\ do\ \{\ int\ playervar\ =\ current_turn;\ int\ cardvar;\ for\(\ cardvar\ =\ active_cards_count\[playervar\]\-1;\ cardvar\ >\ \-1;\ cardvar\-\-\ \)\{\{__VA_ARGS__;\}\}\ playervar\ =\ 1\-current_turn;\ for\(\ cardvar\ =\ active_cards_count\[playervar\]\-1;\ cardvar\ >\ \-1;\ cardvar\-\-\ \)\{\{__VA_ARGS__;\}\}\ \}\ while\ \(0\)

source_constants.name: COMPARE
source_constants.pattern:
\#define\ COMPARE\(a,\ comparator,\ b\)\	\	\\\
\(\{\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\	\\\
\ \ __typeof__\(a\)\ macro_compare_a\ =\ \(a\);\	\\\
\ \ __typeof__\(b\)\ macro_compare_b\ =\ \(b\);\	\\\
\ \ macro_compare_a\ comparator\ macro_compare_b\ \?\ macro_compare_a\ :\ macro_compare_b;\	\\\
\}\)

source_constants.name: IS_CASTING
source_constants.pattern: \#define\ IS_CASTING\(player,\ card,\ event\)\	\(event\ ==\ EVENT_CAN_CAST\ \|\|\ \(event\ ==\ EVENT_CAST_SPELL\ \&\&\ affect_me\(player,\ card\)\)\ \|\|\ event\ ==\ EVENT_RESOLVE_SPELL\)

source_constants.name: IS_ACTIVATING
source_constants.pattern: \#define\ IS_ACTIVATING\(event\)\	\	\	\(event\ ==\ EVENT_CAN_ACTIVATE\ \|\|\ event\ ==\ EVENT_ACTIVATE\ \|\|\ event\ ==\ EVENT_RESOLVE_ACTIVATION\)

source_constants.name: IS_GS_EVENT
source_constants.pattern: \#define\ IS_GS_EVENT\(player,\ card,\ event\)\	\	\(IS_CASTING\(player,\ card,\ event\)\ \|\|\ event\ ==\ EVENT_CHANGE_TARGET\ \|\|\ event\ ==\ EVENT_CAN_CHANGE_TARGET\)

source_constants.name: IS_AURA_EVENT
source_constants.pattern: \#define\ IS_AURA_EVENT\(player,\ card,\ event\)\	\	\(IS_CASTING\(player,\ card,\ event\)\ \|\|\ event\ ==\ EVENT_CHANGE_TARGET\ \|\|\ event\ ==\ EVENT_CAN_CHANGE_TARGET\ \|\|\ event\ ==\ EVENT_CAN_MOVE_AURA\ \|\|\ event\ ==\ EVENT_MOVE_AURA\ \|\|\ event\ ==\ EVENT_RESOLVE_MOVING_AURA\ \|\|\ event\ ==\ EVENT_POWER\ \|\|\ event\ ==\ EVENT_TOUGHNESS\ \|\|\ event\ ==\ EVENT_CHANGE_TYPE\ \|\|\ event\ ==\ EVENT_ABILITIES\ \|\|\ event\ ==\ EVENT_SET_COLOR\ \|\|\ event\ ==\ EVENT_GET_SELECTED_CARD\)

source_constants.name: CAN_ACTIVATE
source_constants.pattern: \#define\ CAN_ACTIVATE\(player,\ card,\ manacost\)\	\(can_use_activated_abilities\(player,\ card\)\ \&\&\ has_mana_for_activated_ability\(player,\ card,\ manacost\)\)

source_constants.name: CAN_ACTIVATE0
source_constants.pattern: \#define\ CAN_ACTIVATE0\(player,\ card\)\	\	\	\	\(can_use_activated_abilities\(player,\ card\)\ \&\&\ has_mana_for_activated_ability\(player,\ card,\ MANACOST_X\(0\)\)\)

scope: Seventeen complete remaining native card owner bodies reviewed and retained verbatim: original files/names, no C source edits. Resolve explicit switch tables, readonly terminator loads, inlined-helper prompts, empty constructor strings, named BSS globals, conditional return-zero stub and fixed EXE call. Preserve observed bugs and incomplete native effects. Five complete source dependencies,109callee contracts,77native enums,46native data ranges,two complete six-entry switches,three named BSS symbols and two one-byte copies pinned. No generic address wildcarding, byte matching, transitive/global-content or gameplay equivalence claim. GUI internals and gameplay tests remain deferred.
